## What's new in 1.4.1

**Every cover in view.** The settings window now shows the box covers of all your releases at once. When they don't fit on one row they wrap onto two (fourteen releases make two rows of seven), so you no longer scroll along the row to find a release. The window opens taller to make room; in a shorter window the covers get smaller, and only the smallest window size still scrolls them.

**Remove a release.** Right-click a cover in the settings window and choose **Remove …** to take that release off your computer. A window asks first. Its modules are deleted, its cover is kept, and you can import it again at any time.

**A shorter importer window.** The importer now shows your installed releases as a grid of their covers instead of a row each, so with many releases imported it no longer fills the screen. Click a cover to change it or to remove the release.
